title: Pure Atlantean
summary: Atlantean cards at the core, with generic staples. The Mermail list covers the wider Mermail family, so this one keeps the Atlantean sea serpents in front, and the page's Deep Sea and Mermail engines are left out. Every Atlantean gets its real effect when it is sent to the GY to pay for a WATER monster's effect: Dragoons searches a Sea Serpent, Heavy Infantry destroys a face-up card, Marksman destroys a Set card, and Neptabyss revives an Atlantean. Neptabyss also mills an Atlantean to search one. The 2024-25 cards provide the costs. Poseidra, the Storming Atlantean, the newest card, sends a WATER monster to summon itself, then mills an Atlantean and bounces a card. Mermail Shadow Squad, always treated as Atlantean, discards to make your monsters Level 7, and Abyssrhine tributes two monsters to fetch a Level 7. Two Level 7s make Abysstrite, which revives a Sea Serpent.
